title: Floods cause Klang residents to evacuate homes | The Star
text:
Floods cause Klang residents to evacuate homes | The Star
KLANG: Heavy rain wreaked havoc in several locations in Klang, Pandamaran and Port Klang Wednesday (Oct 20) evening with several people having to be evacuated from their homes.
Some 500 homes were affected when flood waters overcame residential housing areas at Jalan Mohd Yamin, Taman Chi Liung, Taman Bayu Perdana; Taman Melawis dan Jalan Sekolah.
